info.title: MBNAS Server API
info.description: Canonical web/server contract for MBNAS_server (package mbnas_server). Derived from NAS_Console_API_Contract_20261006.json v1.0.0 with backward-compatible extensions (see x-contract-changelog). Candidate row id is evaluation_id; candidate_id is stable across promotions. Values in examples are not measured results.

servers.description: production HTTPS origin; exact frontend origin CORS allowlist required

get.summary: List runs (newest first) for loading an existing run

200.description: Bearer-authenticated fetch SSE, at-least-once delivery; event id=seq; JSON data uses Event schema. Reconnect with cursor.

get.description: Bearer-authenticated fetch SSE (Content-Type text/event-stream, Cache-Control no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering no). Wire: id:<seq>, event:<type>, data:<json Event>. Replay from after_seq / Last-Event-ID (run-local monotonic, committed before publish). Heartbeat comment every 15s. If the cursor is older than the replay retention the stream emits snapshot.required.

200.description: Authorized artifact bytes; MIME/SHA headers or short-lived signed-url response. Never accepts arbitrary filesystem paths.

get.description: Registry-mediated artifact access. Bearer required unless a valid signed query (sig, exp) is present. Responses: 200 bytes with X-Artifact-Sha256/Content-Type; 401/403 ACCESS_DENIED; 404 MISSING; 409 NOT_READY; 410 EXPIRED (signed url). Never accepts filesystem paths.

200.description: Immutable experiment export bundle with provenance, metrics, lineage, cost ledger and manifests

get.summary: Server presets (default baseline14 example protocol, PILOT_SMOKE)
Run object with resolved_protocol and costs
Candidate detail: lineage, blocks, all immutable evaluations, checkpoints, cost, gates

post.summary: Issue a fresh short-lived signed URL / metadata for an expired artifact reference

BearerAuth.description: Keep token in browser memory only; fetch SSE with Authorization header; no URL/localStorage/export persistence

dataset_yaml.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

train_root.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

search_val_root.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

final_eval_root.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

output_root.description: Absolute Linux server path; existence and allowlist checked by server, not by browser

execution_mode.description: Resolved explicitly; absent pilot calibration implies PILOT, not formal completed registered search.

preset.description: e.g. PILOT_SMOKE; absent means the default baseline14 protocol.

Protocol.description: Attachment nas-policy-design/1.0 body retained as requested provenance; console extension adds web settings. Validate creates immutable actual resolved policy with verified backend/path/budget and declared execution mode. Original DESIGN_EXAMPLE_NOT_EXECUTABLE is not treated as executable by itself.

matching.description: For gt/tp/fn/fp: sample_id, split, checkpoint sha, counts {tp,fp,fn,gt}, sample recall/precision (null when GT=0), matching rule.

id.description: Immutable evaluation_id, unique per point and device/rung/checkpoint; provisional row is mutable until evaluation committed

candidate_id.description: Stable architecture candidate ID, retained across promotion

evaluation_hash.description: Common evaluator protocol/split/metric signature; excludes candidate/checkpoint to support cohort curves. Individual measurement uses id and checkpoint hash.

candidate_status.description: Mutable architecture candidate state; measurement row status remains EVALUATED after its immutable commit.

progress.description: Live training progress of the provisional row; absent on immutable EVALUATED rows except as history.

revision.description: Superseding revision number of this evaluation record.

architecture_id.description: Alias of architecture_hash (structure identity, not trial identity).

namespace.description: Run namespace, e.g. default or pilot_smoke.

source_kind_legend.description: Optional legend of block source kinds used in blocks[].

raw_metrics.description: All raw evaluator outputs (ap_50, counts, latency statistics per scope, size definitions).

fitness_weights.description: Named weights of the source rung applied to this row.

representative_rule.description: current-rung highest fitness → lower latency → stable candidate id

Generation.description: Complete only when planning_closed=true and pending_count=0. Server semantically enforces evaluated_count+failed_count+not_admitted_count+pending_count=planned_count. No representative/line when no valid measured evaluation exists.

ga_billed_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

random_billed_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

actual_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

baseline_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

final_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

purpose.description: e.g. SMOKE for PILOT_SMOKE preset runs.

source_commit.description: Server source identifier (git SHA or source tree sha256).

protocol_canonicalization.description: Canonical JSON + hash algorithm version, e.g. mbnas-canon/1 sha256.

budget.description: Frozen budget per arm/seed in GPU-seconds and admission policy.

cancel.description: Cancel tracking: requested_at, scope, kill/cleanup state.

Event.description: SSE data JSON. seq is run-local and monotonic; duplicates/out-of-order must be deduplicated by the client; gaps require a snapshot.

resolved_diff.description: Every field whose resolved value differs from the request (e.g. optimizer=auto → actual lr, requested vs resolved image shape, execution_mode defaulted to PILOT).

validation_id.description: Server-side id of the frozen validated snapshot; Run may send it to prove non-stale validation.

lineage.description: operation (crossover|clone|mutation|random|baseline), crossover mask/cut, mutation events (before/after), repair events (before/after/reason), source template.

audit.description: config estimate vs built-model operator audit.

x-execution-invariants: Freeze actual resolved protocol and source hashes before run; attachments are design examples.
One architecture candidate may produce many immutable evaluation rows by rung/device/objective.
Plot only finite completed metrics within same fidelity/objective/evaluation/device/precision/input/timing group.
Send generation.completed after planned set closes and pending_count is zero; failures are not points.
Same idempotency key plus same payload reuses run; changed payload conflicts.
Use full-state resume at fixed global horizon; generation restore alone is insufficient.
Source-rung weights gate promotion; passing eligibility is distinct from budget admission.
IndependentRandom sampler prior never consumes observed fitness.
GT/TP/FN/FP artifacts are from same sample and evaluation with deterministic matching.
Track physical GPU and arm-equivalent billed cost separately.
Final retraining/test and search results are separate.
EVALUATED cohort fields protocol_hash/batch/resolved_input_shape/search_seed are mandatory. evaluation_hash excludes per-candidate checkpoints. Complete generation counts must sum to planned_count.
Run uses Validate.resolved and resolved protocol_hash; without calibration, actual execution is explicitly PILOT. Original design example provenance remains unchanged.

changes: One status spelling CANCELLED for runs and candidates (importer maps legacy CANCELED).
Run: enum status, namespace, execution_mode, purpose, preset, updated_at, terminal, source_commit, protocol_canonicalization, budget, cancel; costs add failed/retry/profile seconds.
CandidateEvaluation: progress, attempt, job_id, revision, architecture_id, namespace, execution_mode, raw_metrics, rewards, fitness_weights.
Worker: device_uuid/name, job_id, run_id, attempt, global_step, rung, pid, lease_expires_at, power_w, sm_clock_mhz.
Health: server_time, allowlists, presets, worker_count. ValidateResponse: warnings, resolved_diff, validation_id. RunRequest: validation_id.
New: GET /protocols/presets, GET /registry, GET /runs, GET /runs/{id}, GET /runs/{id}/candidates/{cid}, POST /runs/{id}/artifacts/{aid}/refresh.
Artifact: state, refresh_url, evaluation_id, matching. Generation: group_key, representative_rule.
